Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
•	Approximately 10–12 years of experience implementing and architecting ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
•	Extensive experience across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, CMDB, App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, and platform customization.
•	Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs and IntegrationHub.
•	Hands-on experience leading ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, domain-separated implementations, and enterprise migrations.
•	Experience implementing Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise testing strategies.
•	Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and leading discovery workshops, solution design, and technical governance.
•	Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem is highly desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies:
•	Expert knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
•	Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Service Portal/Workspaces.
•	Deep understanding of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, CMDB, Discovery, and ServiceNow security architecture.
•	Experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
•	Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, integration patterns, and automation frameworks.
•	Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to engage CXO-level audiences.
•	Strong leadership, mentoring, architectural governance, and decision-making capabilities.
•	Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions while driving AI-first digital transformation initiatives.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 






We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 






As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 






Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.




To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.




About the Department - Program 


Join Monash Health as a Quality Systems & Insights Analyst and play a key role in improving the safety and quality of care for one of Victoria's largest health services. Combining data analytics, quality systems expertise and clinical governance insight, you'll transform information into meaningful action, support organisation wide quality systems, and help leaders make decisions that improve patient outcomes. If you enjoy solving problems, working with data, optimising systems, and partnering with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement and positive change, this is an opportunity to make a real impact across a complex and dynamic healthcare environment.


The Quality & Clinical Governance Unit plays a central role in supporting Monash Health's commitment to delivering safe, effective and high-quality care. The team provides leadership, systems and oversight that strengthen clinical governance, quality improvement, patient safety and organisational learning across the health service.


The Quality Insights & Systems team manages and optimises key quality systems, supports the collection and analysis of clinical governance information, and provides meaningful insights that help leaders identify risks, monitor performance and drive continuous improvement. Working collaboratively with programs and services across Monash Health, the team supports evidence-based decision-making and initiatives that enhance patient outcomes and organisational performance.







About the Role 








This is a part time ongoing position located at Monash Medical Centre, Clayton, you will work under the leadership of the Quality Insights & Systems manager and collaborate closely with the broader Quality & Clinical Governance team and stakeholders across Monash Health.


This is an exciting opportunity for a quality systems and data professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking, systems administration and continuous improvement to support safer patient care. The role is responsible for maintaining and optimising key organisational quality systems while developing meaningful clinical governance insights that inform decision-making and improvement initiatives.










Key responsibilities include:



Administering and optimising Monash Health's quality systems, including incident management, document control and audit platforms.


Analysing clinical quality data and other information sources to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. 


Developing and delivering clinical governance reports, dashboards and insights that support leaders and teams. 


Providing user support, education and training to improve staff capability in quality systems and data interpretation. 


Working with internal stakeholders, external vendors and partner teams to enhance system performance, data integrity and governance processes. 


Contributing to quality improvement initiatives, system enhancements and process optimisation projects.









This role will involve working with stakeholders across multiple Monash Health sites. A hybrid working arrangement may be available in line with team and organisational requirements.







About You 


To be successful in this healthcare role, you will bring demonstrated experience in systems administration, data analysis and quality improvement within a complex organisational environment. 


You will be someone who is curious, analytical and solutions-focused, with the ability to translate data into meaningful insights and build strong collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.


You will have:




Experience administering, supporting or improving systems and processes in a complex organisation. 


Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and communicate actionable insights. 


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing, presentations and development of guidance materials.


Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building capabilities. 


Experience providing education, training and support to end-users.


High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining data integrity and quality. 


Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset. 


Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.


Experience using RiskMan, PROMPT, MARS or similar systems will be highly regarded.



Mandatory Requirements:




Degree qualification in health, quality, business management, data analytics or a related discipline.


Current right to work in Australia. 


Ability to obtain and maintain required screening checks, including National Police Check and Working with Children Check.


Current Victorian Driver's Licence is highly desirable



 
Desirable:




Knowledge of quality, safety and clinical governance principles within a health service environment. 


Experience working in a complex healthcare organisation.This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to Monash Health's quality and safety agenda, helping to strengthen systems, generate valuable organisational insights and support continuous improvement across one of Australia's largest health services. 










For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Linda Chuang, Qualtiy Insights & Systems Manager via linda.chuang@monashhealth.org

At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement.

result.description: The Trustee for R & C UNIT TRUST   Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter     Reports to : Project Manager / Site Manager   Direct Reports:  Carpenters / Apprentice / Construction Labourers / Trade Assistants       Position Summary   The Leading Hand Formwork Carpenter is responsible for carrying out hands-on formwork carpentry works while providing day-to-day supervision and guidance to small site crews on major energy infrastructure projects. The role involves constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems, interpreting engineering drawings, coordinating daily work activities and ensuring works are completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with project specifications, quality standards and Work Health and Safety requirements.   Key Duties and Responsibilities   •    Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications and construction plans for formwork and reinforced concrete structures.   •    Measure, cut, assemble, erect and dismantle timber, plywood and engineered formwork for footings, slabs, columns, walls, beams and other concrete structures.   •    Construct, install and maintain formwork systems in accordance with project specifications, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Inspect completed formwork to ensure correct dimensions, alignment, bracing and structural integrity prior to concrete placement.   •    Carry out repairs, modifications and adjustments to formwork and temporary structures as required throughout the construction process.   •    Operate and maintain hand tools, power tools and construction equipment safely and efficiently.   •    Supervise and provide day-to-day guidance to a small team of carpenters and labourers, allocating tasks and monitoring work progress to ensure quality workmanship and timely project delivery.   •    Coordinate daily formwork activities with engineers, site supervisors, steel fixers, concreters and other trades to support efficient project outcomes.   •    Monitor the quality of completed carpentry works and rectify defects where required to ensure compliance with project specifications.   •    Assist with planning material requirements and ensure the safe handling, storage and use of construction materials on site.   •    Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area by identifying and reporting hazards and ensuring compliance with Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and company policies.   •    Complete works within project timeframes while maintaining high standards of workmanship, safety and quality.   Skills, Experience and Qualifications   •    Certificate III in Carpentry (or equivalent overseas qualification), or a higher relevant qualification.   •    Demonstrated experience as a Formwork Carpenter.   •    Proven experience constructing, installing and dismantling formwork systems for reinforced concrete structures.   •    Experience supervising or leading small site crews and coordinating daily construction activities.   •    Sound ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, construction plans and technical specifications.   •    Strong knowledge of formwork systems, construction methods, Australian Standards and quality requirements.   •    Proficiency in the safe operation of hand tools, power tools and construction equipment.   •    Sound understanding of Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS) and safe work practices.   •    Strong communication, leadership, teamwork and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment.   •    Ability to work across multiple project locations, including FIFO/DIDO assignments, as required.   •    Current Construction Induction (White Card) and a valid driver's licence.  •    Additional industry licences or tickets (e.g. Working at Heights, Elevated Work Platform, Dogging, Rigging or First Aid) are advantageous.     About Company     About T&S Construct   T&S Construct is an Australian construction company specialising in formwork, concrete and structural construction services for major civil and energy infrastructure projects. The company delivers high-quality construction solutions across substations, transmission infrastructure, renewable energy developments and other large-scale projects, working collaboratively with principal contractors to achieve safe, efficient and compliant project outcomes.        Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $90000-100000   Job Publish:  06-07-2026   Job Expire:  05-08-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5990066   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

result.description:
Welshpool, Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 20/07/2026 to 17/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17448
- Welder, Fitter, and Fabricator opportunities
- Remuneration between $78,000 and $90,000 per annum
- Join the team at FabWest in Welshpool

FabWest is a multi-disciplinary design/engineering and fabrication company based in Welshpool, Western Australia.

We are currently looking to fill the following vacancies:
- Welder
- General Fitter
- Metal Fabricator

Steel Welders / Fabricators:
- Fabricate and weld structural steel assemblies and pressure pipework
- Stainless steel/mild steel welding (MIG, TIG and Flux-Core)
- Maintenance repairs

Fitters:
- Dismantling/reassembling various types of equipment and trouble shooting/repairs
- Maintenance for water and wastewater infrastructure assets (treatment plants, sewerage networks etc)
- Workshop Plant maintenance and repairs

To be considered for one of these opportunities, you will need hold a relevant qualification and demonstrate at least 1-3 years' previous experience in a similar role.

You'll also need:
- Previous experience in a manufacturing environment
- To be able to read engineering drawings
- The ability to work autonomously & independently as well as part of a team
- Knowledge and amalgamation of both imperial & metric measurement systems
- Use and Knowledge of hand held power & air tools (essential).
- Basic computer and software knowledge
- Understanding of Safe Work Practices/Stop Work Instructions

Remuneration packages will be between $78,000 and $90,000 and will be aligned with the skills and experience you bring to our team.

If you think you have the required skills and experience, APPLY NOW and fill in the online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17448.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right candidate.

result.description:
Our client, Pearson Engineering Pty Ltd, is an engineering company manufacturing and machining. Everything from construction materials to accessories for mining/ plant equipment.

The Role: 
To assemble aluminium components in accordance with work instruction & drawings from supervisor and production staff.
Conduct the work in line with the standard job builds / SOP.
Build jobs as directed by supervisors and production staff, ensure work is built to appropriate standards and within time constraints
Report broken / damaged machinery, making sure all problems are tagged out correctly
Weld and fabricate as required and to specifications
Abide by Company Health and Safety Policies and Government rules
Participate in staff consultation and communications such as Toolbox Talks and training.
2 Full-Time Positions
$70,000-$85,000 PA depending on the work experience.
Locations: NSW

During the conduct of this role you may be required to:
Lift, carry and maneuvers material and equipment through physical and mechanical means
Wear specialized protective equipment
Perform general physical activities including climbing, balancing, sitting and walking
Perform whole body movements that can include twisting, squatting, kneeling, bending and crawling
Perform sustained physical activities
Operate both handheld tooling and heavier machinery
Work at height or within a confined space.

The Person: 
Trade Qualified in a relevant industry is required
Health and Safety training is desirable
Extensive fabrication experience
Understanding of Safe Work Practices
Good ability to communicate effectively
Attention to detail

If you are interested in hearing more about this position, please apply with your updated resume today here:

https://apply.jobadder.com/au1/3420/4457599/jqme2wof7seubcstuloud4ahpe
